payload.claim: `_DETAIL_BOUND=500` was picked by measuring two unrelated fixture lines (a 91-char `baseline:` line and a 67-char `REVIEW:` summary), not the call sites this fix actually targets. `validate_plan` embeds unbounded model-authored text inline before truncation ever runs — `plan.blocking_questions[0]` at saffron/agents/artifacts.py:273, and a pydantic `ValidationError`'s full multi-field rendering at saffron/agents/artifacts.py:268, both then wrapped again in session.py:490/523/528 and rendered here. Multi-error pydantic messages and free-form model 'blocking questions' routinely exceed 500 characters, and `_clean` keeps the first 500 chars and drops the rest, so the diagnostic tail (later validation errors, or the end of the model's own question) is exactly what gets silently cut. Unlike `Agent.bounded`, which marks truncated content with `(bounded, N chars)`, no such marker exists here, so an operator reading a rejected-plan or re-prompt line in `saffron watch` cannot tell a complete reason from a clipped one — a real information-loss regression in the one path (rejected plans) this change exists to make legible.
